chunks: And be dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me haughty or rebellious.
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Yahya pray for regarding his mother and his own character?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often cited to highlight the virtue of *birr al-walidayn* (piety to parents) as a key trait of the prophets, specifically linking Yahya’s devotion to his mother Maryam (AS) who was chosen above all women. The contrast with 'jabbaran shaqiya' (arrogant and wretched) underscores the spiritual danger of pride, a theme frequently emphasized in Shia moral teachings as the root of misfortune.
